title: Utility Services Program Tariff: Submetered Usage Rates and Fixed Service Charges
content:
# Tariff — Submetered Usage Rates and Fixed Service Charges (Utility Services Program)

The Utility Services Program prices metered usage per unit of the service — water and sewer per thousand gallons, natural gas per therm, electricity per kilowatt-hour — and carries a fixed monthly service charge for each metered service on submetered plans. All figures are in US dollars.

## Water and sewer

| Program | Water rate per thousand gallons | Sewer rate per thousand gallons | Monthly fixed water service charge | Monthly fixed sewer service charge | Sewer usage measured by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | not applicable |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | not applicable |
| Submetered Water Plan | $7.85 | $9.40 | $6.50 | $8.25 | metered water usage |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | $7.85 | $9.40 | $6.50 | $8.25 | metered water usage |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | $7.85 | $9.40 | $6.50 | $8.25 | metered water usage |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | $7.85 | $9.40 | $0.00 | $0.00 | metered water usage |

## Natural gas and electricity

| Program | Gas rate per therm | Monthly fixed gas service charge | Electricity rate per kWh | Monthly fixed electric service charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Submetered Water Plan | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | $1.42 | $7.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | $1.42 | $7.00 | $0.1385 | $9.50 |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | $1.42 | $0.00 | $0.1385 | $0.00 |

## Reading the tariff

- The sewer rate is applied to metered water usage on every program whose sewer usage is measured by metered water usage.
- The All-Inclusive Utility Package carries the same per-unit water, sewer, gas and electricity rates as the Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan, and no fixed monthly service charges.

*Worked figure (hypothetical usage):* 3.5 thousand gallons of water on the Submetered Water Plan priced at that plan's water rate of $7.85 per thousand gallons comes to $27.475, which is $27.48 once rounded half up to the cent.
